name: Gur Gur Tea (with a twist)
instructions: 1. Boil water in a pot and add the brick tea leaves, simmering until a strong dark decoction is formed.
2. Strain the tea liquid into a traditional churner or a blender.
3. Add the butter, salt, milk, black pepper, and cardamom powder to the tea.
4. Churn or blend vigorously for a few minutes until the mixture emulsifies and becomes frothy.
5. Heat gently on the stove (do not boil) and serve hot in traditional cups.
description: Gur Gur Tea is a staple of high-altitude life in Ladakh, prized for keeping the body hydrated and warm in freezing temperatures. The 'twist' of adding black pepper and cardamom elevates the flavor profile, adding a modern aromatic dimension to this ancient, nourishing beverage.
